newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady-firm levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady-firm levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to higher levels on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, this week, bid at a steady 135 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, next week, bid at 135 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Five barges, mid-Mississippi River, one each week August, bid at 122-1/2 percent, offered at 135 percent, no comparisons.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi River, one each week September, bid at 175 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week September, bid at 170 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week December, bid 2-1/2 points higher at 162-1/2 percent, offered at 170 percent.
